data_section_full_text:
Sample Selection

We impose minimal requirements on our sample in order to maximize our coverage.
We require firms to be covered by Compustat, incorporated in the U.S. ( FINC - 0), with
ten consecutive years of non-missing cash taxes paid (data317), income tax expense
(data16), and pretax income (data170) during the years 1995–2004. <sup>15,16</sup> Imposing these
requirements results in a sample of 24,390 firm-years, corresponding to 2,439 unique firms
that have an unbroken string of cash taxes paid, income tax expense, and pretax income.

Most of our tests require firms to have positive pretax income when summed over the
ten-year period. This requirement reduces the sample to 2,077 firms.
